fnf-s0.best_idea: Start from a tighter hand-designed mixed packing with larger corner/center circles and smaller edge fillers, then use a small deterministic local search to slightly nudge circles for a better sum while preserving feasibility.

fnf-s1.best_idea: Switch to an optimization-driven search that starts from a high-quality 26-circle template and repeatedly expands radii while repairing overlaps and boundary violations.

fnf-s2.best_idea: Added a stronger initialization bias toward boundary-heavy and staggered hex-like arrangements, plus a more aggressive multi-start perturbation loop to explore better local optima.

parallel-s0.best_idea: Start from a denser hand-designed boundary/interior template closer to strong packings, then run a larger randomized local search with occasional global reshuffles.

parallel-s1.best_idea: Use a stronger local-search optimizer that adjusts both centers and radii from a dense seed, with explicit overlap-barrier scoring to push the packing much closer to a high-sum feasible configuration.

parallel-s2.best_idea: Fix the count bug and use a safer 26-circle layered packing with a guaranteed extra tiny circle, then apply only conservative radius expansion.

single-s0.best_idea: Back off the last over-tightening and try a slightly more balanced tuning of the same template, aiming to recover the previous gain without risking invalidity.

single-s1.best_idea: Switch to a conservative, symmetry-based packing with explicitly separated rings and smaller interior circles to eliminate overlaps while keeping a decent total radius.

single-s2.best_idea: Use a more aggressive but still structured 26-circle pattern with optimized radii via a small deterministic shrink-and-separate procedure.
